notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.8.30.0
notes.content: [h2]Patch Notes - v2025.8.30.0[/h2][p]Just a quick patch before the Best Indie Games Fall Showcase![/p][list][*][p]Added multiple save files[/p][/*][*][p]Convoy vehicles now have thin outlines when "thick outlines" is disabled[/p][/*][*][p]Elite enemies no longer have thick outlines[/p][/*][*][p]Deployable turrets now have 16 sprite directions instead of 8[/p][/*][*][p]Removed "refund" upgrade from turrets[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with UI elements moving too quickly at low frame rates[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.8.26.0
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650251/878448214483bdd73da0f857ca7bdb356fd1639f.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]One of the oldest animals currently living, most think Walter long dead - yet the "King of Grove City" still rules from the shadows.[/i][/p][h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Walter O'Possum![/p][/*][*][p]Removed "Weighted Dice" upgrade for Chuck, and replaced with "Spoils of War"[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Missions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the "Convoy" mission type![/p][/*][*][p]Players must destroy a convoy of vehicles circling the map[/p][/*][*][p]Added arena modifiers to increase convoy HP, vehicle count, vehicle armor, and vehicle shields[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the "King Of Grove City" upgrade - First purchase in each shop is free (exclusive to Walter O'Possum)[/p][/*][*][p]Added the "Center Mass" upgrade - Weapon has 100% accuracy but can no longer crit[/p][/*][*][p]Added the "Homing" upgrade - Projectiles home towards their target[/p][/*][*][p]Homing projectiles will ignore enemies other than their target, unless they have pierce[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Weapons[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Carbine[/p][/*][*][p]Added Smart Rifle[/p][/*][*][p]Added Jammer[/p][/*][*][p]Added Tactical Nuke[/p][/*][*][p]Added more angles for weapons to be pointing, to match the updated number of player directional sprites[/p][/*][*][p]Updated targeting priority for some weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added the "projectile" tag to turrets, increasing the pool of upgrades they can acquire[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where locked weapons on the loadout screen would show their elements[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons now show their targeting priority[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon stat window is now cropped to fit inside game screen, and automatically scrolls when necessary[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips to the map generation screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with ammo indicators having too little precision when drawing circles[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon damage/kill stats are now rounded[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gamepad Controls[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Left stick now snaps to nearest button[/p][/*][*][p]Right stick now moves cursor freely[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a warning sound when the mission timer is getting low[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.8.8.0
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650251/b5680173e53c90ff60619487807c043cf4f3ce41.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Known as "the wrench with a stench," Petals is one of the finest engineers around, yet many find him revolting. Just one of the downsides of being British.[/i][/p][h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Petals![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Weapons now show their elemental type in the bottom corner of the weapon plaque[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon weight is now shown in the stats section when hovering over them in the armory/loadout screen[/p][/*][*][p]Missions now show how many skulls they will award[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with enemy healthbars showing over the flashbang effect[/p][/*][*][p]Ammo indicator circle now adjusts precision based on reload time[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Misc[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with "New York Reload" not working properly for revolvers and tube weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Increased base skulls awarded per mission[/p][/*][*][p]Removed max count for turrets, and increased reload time[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.8.1.0
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650251/d54285f79d61fbe87b1f789ccdecf30ebb55628d.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Heiress apparent to the Badger Mafia, Fyodora forgoes her mother's tact in favor of sheer force - and the cruel temper of a Grovograd winter.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Fyodora - specializes in shotguns, HP, and frost damage![/p][/*][*][p]Chuck - removed Weakpoint upgrade, added Retail Therapy[/p][/*][*][p]Gosling - removed Reverse Speed upgrade, added Weakpoint[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Currency Conversion[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the "Convert Currency" panel to the garage[/p][/*][*][p]Allows the player to convert scrap to cash and vice versa[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New upgrade: "Celebratory Feast" - increases HP regained on level-up[/p][/*][*][p]New upgrade: "Tortoise Shell" - all armor applied to BACK only[/p][/*][*][p]New upgrade: "Pacifist" - weapon deals +100% damage, but can no longer kill or deal elemental dmg[/p][/*][*][p]New upgrade: "Backhoe" - Deal plow and building damage while reversing[/p][/*][*][p]"Fat Reserves": armor effectiveness changed from 0% -> 50%[/p][/*][*][p]"Booze Cruise": accuracy penalty changed from 50% -> 25%[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Accuracy Rework[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Accuracy previously only affected a weapon's spread, which became insignificant once large swarms of enemies appeared[/p][/*][*][p]When dealing damage, weapons now have a chance to deal a "glancing blow," which reduces damage by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Glancing blow chance on hit = (1 - Weapon Accuracy)[/p][/*][*][p]For example, a weapon with 75% accuracy will deal a glancing blow 25% of the time[/p][/*][*][p]Accuracy still affects weapon spread, but shotguns now have a minimum spread amount[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Arena Modifiers[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New modifier: "Piercing Blows" - Increases enemy armor piercing damage[/p][/*][*][p]New modifier: "Special Forces" - increases elite enemy spawn rate[/p][/*][*][p]Removed modifiers that spawned specific elite enemies[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Visuals[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Explosions and shrapnel now create elemental effects[/p][/*][*][p]Damage numbers now create more vertical separation between each other to make them more legible[/p][/*][*][p]Minimap now shows the location of enemy shield generators[/p][/*][*][p]Added a bulldozer animation in the loading screen[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Driller move speed increased from 1.5 m/s -> 2 m/s[/p][/*][*][p]Elite enemies now move 25% faster[/p][/*][*][p]Elite enemies now have a chance to spawn at any time, with the spawn rate and max elite count increasing at higher levels[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Weapons[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Hunting rifle: increased fire rate[/p][/*][*][p]Javelin: increased accuracy[/p][/*][*][p]Updated projectile sprites for crossbow, explosive crossbow, and javelin[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Scrap[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Buildings now drop 10% less scrap[/p][/*][*][p]Destroying a non-target building now removes 5 seconds from the clock[/p][/*][*][p]Armor base scrap cost changed from 10 -> 15[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.7.18.0
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650251/9827d10b6e59b2a4eac6a6098b6fa784f606b9b6.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]None have found a way to kill Bucky yet - no matter how he searches. Tortured by his past, only in a blaze of glory may the "Kamikaze Cockerel" atone.[/i][/p][h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Bucky, the Kamikaze Cockerel![/p][/*][*][p]Specializes in explosive weapons[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New upgrade: "Stopping Power" - increased weapon knockback[/p][/*][*][p]New upgrade: "Retail Therapy" - coins restore HP[/p][/*][*][p]Elemental upgrades (e.g. Hailstorm, Short Circuit, etc.) will now only appear if the player has a weapon with the relevant element[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Buildings[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the Hardware Store building type, which drops large amounts of wood[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Map Generation[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reworked the map generation algorithm to better distribute special locations (Armory, Black Market, etc.) throughout the map[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Visuals[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Wood collectibles now travel to the player portrait when collected[/p][/*][*][p]Added trail effects for projectiles with elemental upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]While in a mission, the cursor will disappear if not moved for 1 second[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug preventing Shotgunners from spawning[/p][/*][*][p]Increased HP for elite enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Hacker frequency[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Weapons[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Revolvers now reload one bullet at a time (total reload time remains the same)[/p][/*][*][p]Shrapnel now travels at a fixed speed instead of being tied to the parent projectile's speed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with shrapnel playing the parent weapon's sound effect[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.7.11.0
notes.content: [h3][b]Garage[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the "Remove Weapon Upgrades" panel[/p][/*][*][p]Spend scrap to remove upgrades from weapons[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Projectiles fired from the "Dual Wield" upgrade now start on the opposite side of the bulldozer, instead of the same position as the original projectile[/p][/*][*][p]New upgrade: "Refund" - weapon has chance to use no ammo when firing[/p][/*][*][p]New upgrade: "Double Tap" - weapon deals extra damage against damaged enemies[/p][/*][*][p]New upgrade: "Handicraft" - scrap cost for repairs, armor upgrades, etc. reduced[/p][/*][*][p]New upgrade: "Symbiosis" - when a weapon gets a kill, a different weapon gains +1 ammo or speeds up its reload[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Visuals[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed cockpit and flee sprites for Izumi[/p][/*][*][p]Added exhaust smoke that emanates from the dozer[/p][/*][*][p]Explosions now create smoke[/p][/*][*][p]Scrap and coins now travel to their respective HUD icons when collected [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the "Flash" status affect that enemies can inflict on the player, which impedes the player's vision when they hit the player[/p][/*][*][p]No enemies have it by default yet, but added an arena modifier to give ranged enemies flash, and one to give all enemies flash[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.7.4.0
notes.content: [p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650251/e47202d478ce6f2bbf25915fdff077c1f4c63382.gif"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a new hero, Izumi - Master Of 1,000 Needles[/p][/*][*][p]Marvin : Replaced Quick Hands (Heavy) with Jobsite Experience[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the Shotgunner enemy type[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Elite Shotgunner enemy type[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Difficulty[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the formula for tier difficulty [/p][p]Starting at Tier 2, enemies gain a +50 starting level bonus. This bonus doubles each tier, so Tier 3 -> 100, Tier 4 -> 200, Tier 5 -> 400, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings now gain extra health that scales with arena level[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]New Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p]"Luck" : gives the player a chance to take zero damage when hit[/p][/*][*][p]"Hail Storm" : frozen enemies shatter into a burst of projectiles on death[/p][/*][*][p]"Poison Barbs" : Deal poison damage when hit by a melee enemy[/p][/*][*][p]"Smite" : Shock damage no longer spreads, but instantly deals all of its damage in a small radius[/p][/*][*][p]"Up In Smoke" : Fire damage ticks twice as quickly[/p][/*][*][p]"Mag Dump" : Upgraded weapon shoots more rapidly while firing continuously[/p][/*][*][p]"Extended Bags" : +X ammo (thrown weapons only)[/p][/*][*][p]"Guard Up" : While a weapon is reloading, that side gains +10 armor[/p][/*][*][p]"New York Reload" : Every 2nd reload is reduced to 0.5 seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Garage[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Separated repairs and armor upgrades into two different panels, each with an button to access[/p][/*][*][p]New system allows for new panels to be added in the future[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Visuals[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the sprite for the destroyed bulldozer to have empty cockpit[/p][/*][*][p]Added cloud shadows that move along the ground in the arena[/p][/*][*][p]Added more sprites for gun smoke[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.6.18.0
notes.content: [h1]Patch Notes - v2025.6.18.0[/h1][p][/p][h2]Visuals[/h2][list][*][p]Doubled the number of directions the player can face from 8 -> 16[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Thick Outlines" option which can be toggled under Video Options[/p][/*][*][p]Added bullet casings that are dropped when a weapon fires/reloads, depending on weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Pilot is now shown running from the wreckage after the player is destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]Added a small flash effect to bullets when fired[/p][/*][/list][h2]Buildings[/h2][list][*][p]Added a system for different random building types[/p][/*][*][p]Added one new type of building, the "Bank," which drops Cash instead of Scrap[/p][/*][/list][h2]Upgrades[/h2][list][*][p]Added the "Thorns" upgrade, which causes melee enemies to take damage when they hit the player[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]Debug logs are now written to file. Can be found in %localappdata% -> ProjectGranby -> logs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with screenshot file names[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.content: [h1]Patch Notes - v2025.6.12.0[/h1][list][*][p]Hovering over a character in the character select screen now shows their primary ability[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering over a weapon in the loadout screen or the armory now shows the weapon's stats[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2025.6.11.0
notes.content: [h1]Patch Notes - v2025.6.11.0[/h1][list][*][p]Added the "Collateral Damage" upgrade, which allows weapons to deal damage to buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Added a delay to coins and scrap being attracted to the player, to better show what the player is collecting[/p][/*][*][p]Updated game logo[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Pressing the pause/play button while the options menu is open during a mission will now resume the game[/p][/*][*][p]Potentially fixed a bug where the game freezes after generating a new map[/p][/*][/list]
